description: Implementation of QuicConnectionLogger class for logging and metrics collection in QUIC protocol connections.

classes.name: QuicConnectionLogger
classes.description: A class responsible for logging QUIC connection events and metrics.

methods.name: UpdatePublicResetAddressMismatchHistogram
methods.description: Updates histogram for address mismatch in public reset packets.

methods.name: GetRealAddressFamily
methods.description: Returns the address family, converting IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses to IPv4.

methods.name: QuicConnectionLogger
methods.description: Constructor initializing the logger with session, description, watcher, and net log.

methods.name: ~QuicConnectionLogger
methods.description: Destructor that records various metrics and histograms.

methods.name: OnFrameAddedToPacket
methods.description: Handles logging for different frame types added to packets.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Logs packet sent events with size and encryption level.

methods.name: OnPingSent
methods.description: Marks that a ping was sent.

methods.name: OnPacketReceived
methods.description: Logs packet reception and updates address info.

methods.name: OnIncorrectConnectionId
methods.description: Increments counter for incorrect connection IDs.

methods.name: OnAttemptingToProcessUndecryptablePacket
methods.description: Logs attempt to process undecryptable packets.

methods.name: OnPacketHeader
methods.description: Processes packet header info and updates packet number stats.

methods.name: OnIncomingAck
methods.description: Logs acknowledgment frames and updates received ACKs.

methods.name: OnPublicResetPacket
methods.description: Handles public reset packets and updates address mismatch histogram.

methods.name: OnCryptoHandshakeMessageReceived
methods.description: Logs received crypto handshake messages and processes SHLO for address info.

methods.name: OnRttChanged
methods.description: Handles RTT change events and notifies socket watcher.

methods.name: RecordAggregatePacketLossRate
methods.description: Records overall packet loss rate in histogram.
